name: Coastal
signature: Sand page, sea-glass bands, deep-sea ink, coral buttons, one wave divider.

contrast.note: Light theme. Coral is safe as text on the sand background and passes on the sea-glass surface. White on coral passes AA.

motion.rule: Drift: elements float up 28px over 800ms on a slow ease, and a service marquee glides at 90px per second.

hero.layout: Wide photo of the real work or location with a solid deep-sea band at the bottom holding the headline and buttons; a single SVG wave edge between photo and the sand page.
hero.photo: Real outdoor or on-site photo; bright daylight preferred.

background: Sand page with sea-glass surface bands separated by one two-point wave SVG edge in the band color. No gradients.

button.fill: Accent fill, white label; secondary is a 2px ink outline.
button.label: Weight 700, sentence case.
